title: I Automated My Video Ads with Elevenlabs Agent
description:
Try ElevenCreative (my partner link + code):
https://try.elevenlabs.io/8n9sgoi23fkk


What you'll see:
- What ElevenCreative, Flows, and the Flows Agent actually are
- Building a full video pipeline from one plain-English sentence
- Iterating conversationally (warmer voice, swap the video model) without rewiring anything
- Non-destructive iteration - only the part that changed re-runs
- Assist mode: approve-each, auto-run, and auto-under-threshold so you control the spend
- The async superpower: start it, close the tab, come back to a finished Flow
- Honest limitations: it's in alpha, and iterating is not free

A few honest notes: Flows is currently in alpha, so the UI may look a little different when you try it. The Flows Agent chat is billed on tokens and generations use normal credits, so iterating costs money each time. That's why I recommend setting Assist mode with a cost threshold. You get 50+ image and video models in there (Veo 3, Sora 2, Kling, Seedance, Flux, Nano Banana, and more) plus the full ElevenLabs audio stack - Eleven v3 text to speech, voice cloning, lip-sync, sound effects, and music.

If this helped, subscribe for more honest AI agents and automation tutorials.
